result:
**Round 166: C verdict PASS.** I found no bugs, and every check that can run in the cloud browser was run, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. The only blocked item is the fake-Bearer 403 check, because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

- **Source and diff:** HEAD is `7581483`. The 973 frozen files and A's 12 end hashes matched at the start and end of my run, and no source changed while I worked. I diffed the changes myself: each file changes only what the task allows, `StudioWorkspace.tsx` has exactly 2 hunks, no assertion was weakened (`expect(` counts all went up), and doc 135 has every template section.
- **Targeted tests:** the 11 test files A ran pass 211/211 in my re-run. The five new tests (MS4, DPS5, TU11, TS7, LG4) are there and pass. I did not run the full suite or verify; those are the gate's.
- **Icons, at both 1280×720 and 1440×900:**
  - Each spot shows exactly one hidden icon of the right kind. Sizes are 9 px for the marker arrows, 10 px for the toggle and grid check, 12 px for the back arrow.
  - Every icon is vertically centred, and the marker and check icons are also centred horizontally.
  - Icon colour follows the button's colour at rest and on hover.
  - The marker `+` is still text, and none of the old symbols remain.
  - Screen-reader names are as specified; the back link now reads "CZABA".
- **Layout shift:** in all 6 states (3 per screen size) the largest move is 0.468 px, with nothing added or missing. That is exactly what B predicted, inside the ±1 px limit. The full-page comparison against round 164 also matches after the 6 planned name changes, with no element over 1 px and contrast unchanged.
- **Real use, starting each click on the icon itself:**
  - **Marker step:** from 0, the arrows jump to 2.000 → 6.000 → back to 2.000, and focus stays on the button. Ctrl+→ / Ctrl+← still work, and `+` adds a marker at 4 s.
  - **Details toggle:** works by click, Enter and Space, with the right icon, text and expanded state each time.
  - **Grid menu (at 120 BPM):** choosing 1/8 and Snap moves the check correctly. Arrow keys plus Enter still choose, and Esc closes.
  - **Playback:** after 1.5 s the playhead is at about 1.47 s and real audio output is present.
  - **Back link:** clicking the arrow goes to `/`.
- **Premium access:** a fresh browser with no login opens the demo at `/studio-lab`. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. No forbidden requests, no Authorization headers, no hydration or page errors.

One run had to be replaced: the first page load at 1440 came up white because the dev server was still compiling the new icons on first load. The task allows replacing that one run, and I kept its screenshot.

Notes for B, not bugs:
- The checked state of "Triplets (3)" in the grid menu was never shown in the browser. Only unit test TU11 covers it.
- The "CZABA" name for the back link is B's ruling, and Saba can still veto it.
- Doc 135's status line still says it is waiting for C round 166.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-166.md`
- `c-round-166.json`
- `c-round-166/` (scripts in `tools/`, measurements in `out/`, screenshots in `shots/`)
